notes: - **Code rest and spread** use two cells for the three dots. The dots balance the gaps after commas and opening delimiters. A leading blank gives them a wider rhythm while keeping its own advance.
- **Sans and System** carry forward their 1.1.3 outlines and layout.
- All three families include upright and italic styles, print specimens, and a browser proof. [Interactive proof](https://daikonic-org.github.io/transit-typeface/).
